costRounding: round to nearest $5 after multiplying (verified: Dart $200 -> 170/215/240; Quincy $540 -> 460/585/650) CAVEAT (2026-11-05): bloonswiki's Easy figures round upgrade-price halves DOWN (Cold Snap 350 -> 295, Flash Bomb 2,250 -> 1,910; Ice 0-0-5 Easy total 30,085, Ninja 0-0-4 7,135, Sniper 5-0-0 36,125 only reconcile that way); base-price halves are inconsistent (Sniper/Engineer 350 -> 300 but Beast Handler 250 -> 210). Half-up rounding can overstate an Easy price by $5.
popModel: data/pop-model.json is the source of truth for 'can it pop X' (v0.5). Per-upgrade 'grants' was renamed '_grants_deprecated' and must not be used for pop checks; 'innate' is now generated from pop-model.json at 0-0-0; 'damageType' marks upgrades that change the tower's damage type.
